snippet.title: Ice Demon Gameplay Trailer (Latest version in description)
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer of a game that I made. The footage you see is actually an old version; the full version is available for download here:
http://www.suitgames.com/icedemon/

Also I don't have really good feelings about this video quality but with my crappy computer I probably can't really do much better.

Criticism is appreciated if it is available.
